metadata.title: Resolución DINAVISA N° 88, por la cual se establece el procedimiento para la emisión de la constancia de implementación de las Buenas Prácticas de Farmacovigilancia (BPFV) por parte de titulares de registros sanitarios de medicamentos
metadata.edition: Published March 2025 (upload month; 1 March 2025 is a placeholder day) · BPFV implementation certificate for registration holders; scan with no text layer, title only (Spanish)
metadata.legal_basis: DINAVISA resolution; the official Spanish text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
